name: eu-ted-tenders-scraper
title: Tender Data API – EU European Tenders, TED Europa, CPV Codes
description: A procurement data API for EU's official TED journal: search government tenders by country, CPV code, date or open submission deadline. Returns clean, deduplicated JSON in 24 EU languages: buyer, value, deadlines, CPV codes and notice link. Includes tender notices, contract awards and corrigenda.
